scripts.build-flow-types: mkdir -p dist && cp build/mapbox-gl.js.flow dist/mapbox-gl.js.flow && cp build/mapbox-gl.js.flow dist/mapbox-gl-dev.js.flow
scripts.build-style-spec: cd src/style-spec && npm run build && cd ../.. && mkdir -p dist/style-spec && cp src/style-spec/dist/* dist/style-spec
scripts.watch-benchmarks: BENCHMARK_VERSION=${BENCHMARK_VERSION:-"$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD) $(git rev-parse --short=7 HEAD)"} rollup -c bench/rollup_config_benchmarks.js -w
scripts.start: run-p build-token watch-css watch-query watch-benchmarks start-server
scripts.start-release: run-s build-token build-prod-min build-css print-release-url start-server
scripts.diff-tarball: build/run-node build/diff-tarball && echo "Please confirm the above is correct [y/n]? "; read answer; if [ "$answer" = "${answer#[Yy]}" ]; then false; fi
scripts.test: run-s lint lint-css lint-docs test-flow test-unit
scripts.test-suite-clean: find test/integration/{render,query, expressions}-tests -mindepth 2 -type d -exec test -e "{}/actual.png" \; -not \( -exec test -e "{}/style.json" \; \) -print | xargs -t rm -r
scripts.test-cov: nyc --require=@mapbox/flow-remove-types/register --reporter=text-summary --reporter=lcov --cache run-s test-unit test-expressions test-query test-render
scripts.prepublishOnly: run-s prepare-publish build-flow-types build-dev build-prod-min build-prod build-csp build-css build-style-spec test-build diff-tarball
